collection.description: Two adult partners realize their hopes for the future no longer match.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (partner1) and (partner2), two adult partners, realize their hopes for the future no longer match.

choices.label: Seek Advice from a Trusted Elder

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: They find one goal they still share and begin again.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: They recognize that affection alone cannot settle the disagreement.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: A new routine restores some closeness.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The experiment confirms they want different lives.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: They part sadly without blaming each other.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: One partner needs more time before accepting the separation.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: (elder) helps them listen without choosing sides.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: The advice feels too traditional, and the couple decides for themselves.
